stimuli.description: A furnished living room (4.7 m x 4.4 m, height 3.1 m) with windows shielded from daylight. Temperature 23.3°C, humidity 21.3%. Equipped with eight LED lighting panels (600x600 cm, 53W, 4694 lm, 3000 n, 5000K). Two lighting conditions: 1) direct/indirect lighting (400 lx downlight, 300 lx uplight) and 2) direct lighting (700 lx downlight). Illuminance (700 lx) and color temperature (5000K) were controlled.
stimuli.source: Environmental setting, Design and procedure sections, Figure 1

tables.description: Within-group subjective parameter comparisons (mean, SD, t-value) for Refreshing, Cool, Comfort, Arousal, and Valence between direct/indirect and direct lighting conditions.

limitations: Subjective feelings toward the environment can be altered depending on the amount of sunshine, lighting hardware, length of suspended lighting, interior decoration, and other variables.
The study did not employ multiple comparisons due to its explorative nature, potentially leading to type 1 errors.
Participants may have assumed the hypothesis, influencing results, as they were only informed about the overall purpose of the study.
Although the sample size was sufficient for EEG activity, it is still small for generalization of results.
